c74object.name: v8ui
c74object.description: Touch Multi-Dial component implemented via v8ui.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: Selects between touch and mouse handling: 0 = Touch (discrete stepping on tap, hold-to-repeat, distance-based inertia easing on drag) 1 = Mouse (direct rotary or linear pointer drag tracking)

attribute.name: count
attribute.description: Number of active dials in the strip array (1 to 8).

attribute.name: dial_spacing
attribute.description: Pixel spacing distance between consecutive dials along the primary strip axis.

attribute.name: dial_size
attribute.description: Relative radius of the dial platter (0.0 to 1.0).

attribute.name: dial_style
attribute.description: 0 = Ribbon (donut rail with filled arc or line), 1 = Rail (thin guide rail with sliding orb knob).

attribute.name: labels
attribute.description: Space-separated list of token labels applied sequentially across the dials (e.g. Gain Freq Res Pan).

attribute.name: multiplier
attribute.description: Linear scaling coefficient applied to the scaled value before computing MC DSP gain.

attribute.name: gain_exponent
attribute.description: Exponential power curve factor applied to values sent to outlet 1 (default: 1.6).

attribute.name: use_gain_curve
attribute.description: Toggles between exponential power-curve shaping (1) and linear gain multiplication (0) for outlet 1.
